item.title: [+1] India offers to help restore Black Sea grain exports as the PM and Ukraine's president discuss peace
item.description:
Ukraine says India is ready to mediate food corridors; Black Sea cargo traffic is down 37%. Builds on earlier corridor proposals.

Agri & fertilisers: mild tailwind (+1) — Cheaper inputs

Why it matters: Restored Black Sea grain and edible oil flows would ease world food prices and India's food inflation.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
